purpose: Explanatory empirical position-prior control for causal Match-3; no token identities or group products enter prediction.
scope_limit: This is a calibrated empirical baseline, not an analytic Bayes upper bound and not an architectural pass threshold.
label_definition: At element t, positive iff there exist i<j<t with g_i*g_j*g_t equal to identity in A5.
mask_note: BOS and the first two group elements are unscored because no triple can end there. Each sequence contributes14 scored labels.

calibration.rng: numpy.random.default_rng (PCG64), one persistent generator across batches

decision_rules.position_balanced_accuracy: Predict1 iff estimated p_t > estimated global prevalence pi; ties predict0.
decision_rules.position_accuracy: Predict1 iff estimated p_t >0.5; ties predict0.
decision_rules.constant_calibrated_majority: Predict the calibration-set majority label at every scored position; balanced accuracy is exactly0.5 when both labels are present.
decision_rules.derivation: BA=0.5*[sum_t w_t p_t h_t/pi + sum_t w_t(1-p_t)(1-h_t)/(1-pi)]. Setting h_t=1 improves this calibration objective iff p_t/pi > (1-p_t)/(1-pi), equivalently p_t>pi. Here w_t=1/14 over scored positions. Accuracy is sum_t w_t[p_t h_t+(1-p_t)(1-h_t)], optimized pointwise by p_t>0.5.
decision_rules.selection_note: All decision rules are frozen from independent calibration. Heldout labels do not choose thresholds or positions.

uncertainty_note: Standard errors cluster all14 scored labels within each independent sequence; balanced-accuracy influence combines the two class-recall ratio influences. Intervals are normal approximations, not selection criteria.
